anchor.statement: Proposition 7.6. For every α ∈ R and every real two-vector Σ (R, Z, T) ∈ M α independent of the angular and auxiliary variables, (7.31) defines a linear operation L Σ . Its harmonic coefficients on the slow neighborhood satisfy the local derivative and envelope bounds of W α −1/2 , with smooth zero extension at the shell edges. With the slow cutoffs shown explicitly, its bounds and covariance are η β L Σ ∈ W α −1/2 , B(W 0 , L Σ ) = Σ , C( η β L Σ ) ∈ M 2 α −1 . (7.32) The denominator a σ remains this fixed coefficient at every correction stage. No sign or relative-size restriction is imposed on Σ in Proposition 7.6.

correspondence.note: B(W0, LΣ) = Σ is stated per box in the algebraic form H(2a ⊙ δa) = R and for the waves assembled over all boxes; the class statements assume mean-class bounds on (H^{−1}Σ)_j and a lower bound on (H^{−1}T)_j rather than Σ ∈ M_α. Smooth zero extension at the shell edges is not stated.

  (sys : NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.SlotSystem D h vr vt) (hdet : vr.1 * vt.2 - vr.2 * vt.1 ≠ 0) (N : ℕ),
  1 ≤ N →

          NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.PairData sys (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.tailLabel N U))

      0 < q →

          ∀ (x : NavierStokes.SlotColoring.Position) (T0 σ : NavierStokes.SignedCovariance.Vec2),
            (∀ (U : NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.UnsignedLabel),
                NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.mask D (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.tailLabel N U) q x ≠ 0 →
                  NavierStokes.SmoothCovariance.StrictCone (P U).matrix
                    (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.chartTarget h q N T0 U)) →
              ∀ (i : Fin 2),
                (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.doubleAverage
                    fun (Y : NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.Plane) (θ : ℝ) =>
                    NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.assembledRadial P hdet
                          (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.physicalOuter h N)
                          (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.physicalViscosity h N)
                          (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.chartTarget h q N T0) q x Y θ *
                        NavierStokes.SignedCovariance.signedTangent P hdet
                          (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.physicalOuter h N)
                          (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.physicalViscosity h N)
                          (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.chartTarget h q N T0)
                          (NavierStokes.SignedCovariance.chartStress h N σ) q x i Y θ +
                      NavierStokes.SignedCovariance.signedRadial P hdet
                          (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.physicalOuter h N)
                          (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.physicalViscosity h N)
                          (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.chartTarget h q N T0)
                          (NavierStokes.SignedCovariance.chartStress h N σ) q x Y θ *
                        NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.assembledTangent P hdet
                          (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.physicalOuter h N)
                          (NavierStokes.PartitionedCovariance.physicalViscosity h N)
